source: temp/p3_live/feature_list_live.py — the one authorized live confirmation of the REST Feature-List contract (P3, 2026-09-19).
purpose: Confirms the operation's described body `{ "rollbackIndex": integer }` and the documented `-1` end-of-list sentinel. -1 is chosen deliberately: it is the only position guaranteed valid for any Feature List, and the fact being bought here is the payload shape, not list arithmetic.
testPurpose: Replay: the recorded response must parse through feature_list.summarize_rollback and report rollbackIndex/sourceMicroversion.
responseHeaders: Not persisted: the shared OnshapeClient returns the parsed body only. The call's status and time are in this file; rate-limit headers land in onshape_rest_api_mode/config/api-usage.json.
